dct_description_sm: One tile of Toitū Te Whenua Land Information New Zealand's 1 m LiDAR-derived DEM for the Nelson region, read straight from the nz-elevation bucket on the AWS Registry of Open Data. Here because it is a real LERC-compressed Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF: LERC is what Esri publishes most of its raster data as, and decoding it needs a WebAssembly module that has to be compiled into the bundle deliberately - see src/lib/lerc.ts. Single-band Float32 in EPSG:2193, so it is drawn through the colour-ramp pipeline in src/lib/previewers/cog-pipeline.ts and reprojected on the fly.
